title: Finite-presentation coordinate kernel on module stalks
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F$ a finitely presented module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], $\mathcal G$ any module sheaf and $x\in X$. Write $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $N=\mathcal G_x$, and $H=\mathcal Hom(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], with module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. There exist an open $U\ni x$, integers $m,n\geq0$, sections $s_i\in\mathcal F(U)$, linear maps $a:R^m\to R^n$, $b:R^n\to\mathcal F_x$, and $\beta:H\to N^n$ such that $b$ is surjective, $\operatorname{Im}a=\operatorname{Ker}b$, $b(e_i)=(s_i)_x$, and $\beta$ is injective with image $\operatorname{Ker}\alpha$. Here $\theta_k:\operatorname{Hom}_R(R^k,N)\to N^k$ sends a map to its values on the standard basis, and $\alpha=\theta_m\circ(a^*)\circ\theta_n^{-1}$. For every open $W\ni x$, local morphism $\varphi$ over $W$, and $i<n$, $\beta(\varphi_x)_i=(\varphi_{U\cap W}(s_i|_{U\cap W}))_x$. This statement constructs a finite presentation and sheaf-side kernel coordinates; it asserts no comparison isomorphism between $H$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_R(\mathcal F_x,N)$.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP on 2026-10-13

proof.text: Choose a finite free presentation of F on a neighborhood U of x. Its generator images give the sections s_i. The cokernel presentation is right exact and remains so on stalks, yielding a surjective b and exact pair a,b.
Apply the finite-presentation internal-Hom kernel theorem on U, obtaining the injective coordinate evaluation into the finite product of G and the relation map.

Taking stalks preserves this kernel. A finite tuple of germs is represented on the intersection of finitely many neighborhoods; equality of such tuples is similarly checked after a finite intersection. These component-germ maps identify the stalks of finite free modules with R^k and of finite products of G with N^k. The relation map becomes theta_m composed with precomposition by a and theta_n inverse. Hence beta is injective and its range is the stated kernel.

Neighborhoods inside U are cofinal, so restricted module stalks agree with original stalks. The local-morphism sections of internal Hom also agree under restriction. Take germs of the sectionwise coordinate formula on U intersect W; this gives the formula for beta for arbitrary W.
